profit_quality.assessment: The business was profitable in 2023-2025, but the profit-to-cash record is uneven. 2025 operating cash flow was strong at RMB68.629 million, helped by RMB38.399 million inventory release; 2024 operating cash flow was only RMB0.957 million despite RMB34.562 million profit.
adjustments: Used the 2023-2025 parent net profit median as a profit anchor but capped pre-haircut distributable cash profit at RMB25.0 million, close to 2025 profit.
Deducted an estimated RMB5.0 million maintenance capex against 2025/2024 PPE cash purchases of RMB3.665 million and RMB7.609 million.
Deducted an estimated RMB10.0 million normalized working-capital reinvestment because receivables increased in both 2025 and 2024 and 2025 cash flow benefited from inventory reduction.
Applied a 0.65 cash profit haircut due to volatile operating cash conversion, no dividend declaration, and reliance on continued marketing/distribution spend.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 OCF / profit was about 2.78x, but excluding the inventory release it falls much closer to reported profit; 2024 OCF / profit was about 0.03x.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: The two-year cash flow evidence is mixed and the group has not shown a stable dividend/distribution record, so the main denominator is materially discounted instead of null.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Medium-low: 2025 cash conversion looks strong but is partly working-capital release; 2024 was poor.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Estimated at RMB5.0 million from the two-year range of PPE acquisition cash outflows.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables increased in both years; inventory release in 2025 may not repeat.
